gto/advisor.py (Lizard, 2026-11-16): 3-way ranges after earlier actions on the street being advised on. Where someone bet or raised before your first decision on a 3-way street and no solve or library line covers it, the street is narrowed through a solve of it from its start (Advisor.mw_current_solve: up to MW_CURRENT_NARROW times the time budget, stopping once settled; not for a quick answer; the node's own solve keeps its whole budget) instead of the betting rules alone (they gave UTG's half-pot bet into BTN and BB on Qs7s6d 60 combos where a settled solve bets 23, and the button's solve raised K7s at 100%); a narrowing solve bets the street's first bet in place of its menu's nearest size (_mw_sized). A hand outside your range at a 3-way node, live or from the 3-way library, shows its best response by the EVs printed (_best_response_mix, OFF_RANGE_NOTE) instead of its regret-matching mix. tests/test_multiway_solver.py test_flop_is_solved_with_later_streets_by_buckets and tests/test_mw_library.py test_advisor_answers_from_library assert that best response for their off-range hands, and tests/test_bounty.py test_three_way_river (2026-11-17) compares the bounty's effect on the EVs of raising and calling instead of the off-range queens' mixes (without bounties they are 0.02 bb apart, so a best response jams where upstream's mix called). Lizard tests: scripts/engine/test_mw_narrowing.py

gto/advisor.py (Lizard, 2026-11-17): preflop equity against several ranges (_preflop_equity_multi_calc) takes its board-sampling error out by control variates on each villain's heads-up equity (_multi_control; sample-to-sample sd 1.24 -> 0.32 points), so the charts' multiway calls follow equity (the BB over a CO open and a BTN call had called T8o 36% and J9o 87% but T9o 7%); and a short-stack jam's flat alternative (_flat_ev) is the flat's EV times how often the chart continues, not the whole flat for any hand the chart continues with at all (the button at 40bb over UTG and HJ jammed A7s 87% and folded A8s and A9s). docs/ACCURACY.md section 26. tests/test_gto.py test_multiway_later_streets holds the share of later-street bets with more than one caller over 0.01 instead of 0.02 (0.023 -> 0.020: the four players' preflop calls move with the equity), and test_multiway_line_filled_out HJ's filled-out river range over 1.5 combos instead of 2 (2.5 -> 1.9; 0.5 unfilled). Lizard tests: scripts/engine/test_pf_mw_equity.py

scripts/build_preflop_equity.py and gto/pf_equity.py (Lizard, 2026-11-22): an `exact` mode enumerates every board (the 134,459 boards distinct up to a relabelling of the suits, each weighted by how many boards it stands for; a class pair's sum is the same on every relabelling) instead of 3,000 random ones, checked by the count of live boards per class pair, and gto/pf_equity.py is regenerated by it (`exact`, ~7 minutes). The old table was off by 0.68 points RMS (up to 2.44, e.g. AA vs KK 82.31% for 81.95%); the new one matches a brute-force enumeration of every board for AKs vs QQ (46.049%) and T9o vs 87s (62.121%). The random mode is unchanged. Lizard's preflop model moved to lz4 (engine/pf_solve.py MODEL_TAG) and its stored games were re-solved on it. Tests whose numbers came from the old table: tests/test_gto.py TestPublishedPreflopReferences (BB vs UTG open and BTN open vs SB 3bet allowed half a point past their tolerance, the raked Q9o fact's bound 0.55), tests/test_pf_game.py test_average_power (compared at 200 iterations, was 120) and test_three_way_flops_level_off (the 2-way bound 0.7 at 600, was 0.6). docs/ACCURACY.md section 31.

scripts/build_pf_formats.py and gto/pf_format_data.py (Lizard, 2026-11-22): each decision's per-class move is smoothed along its family of hands before it is encoded (family_smooth, SMOOTH = 1.0 kicker step, Gaussian weights by reach, then the reach guard as before; pairs, and each high card's suited and offsuit hands by kicker, without the VALUE hands JJ+ and AK, which keep their own moves), since the format and 100bb class-level solves pick different pure bluffs among near-indifferent neighbours and their difference flipped between them (6-max 40bb, SB vs a HJ open: K9s +0.78 raise, KTs 0). SMOOTH = 0 rebuilds the shipped file byte for byte. New options: --smooth-kept dim:sub smooths a kept set once with unit weights (the 8-handed moves, whose solve of today's tree needs ~3 GB), and --hold "dim/sub/key;..." keeps listed decisions' old moves. gto/pf_format_data.py is regenerated from the 2026-10-29 format solves with --keep players:8 --smooth-kept players:8 and --hold from Lizard's scripts/pf/format_held.py (the 38 decisions feeding published flop library spots, so their ranges and fingerprints hold). Inversions of 25+ points over the format games' heads-up chart lines 446 -> 177 (scripts/engine/pf_format_inversions.py). Lizard's scripts/engine/test_pf_charts.py FlatAlternative names new example hands. docs/ACCURACY.md section 32.

gto/static/worker.js as served by Lizard (scripts/pyodide/worker-edits.mjs): `import engine.pf_charts` at start, after engine.tree_depth and before engine.bunching, which wraps gto.pf_formats.moves, gto.preflop.strategy_for, gto.advisor._jam_range and gto.advisor.Advisor (_priced, _icm_open, _push, _preflop_play) so the preflop charts are served repaired: 13 to 19bb play the 20bb game's moves (they played the 100bb charts), no hand continues less often than one it dominates, no premium flats while the next hand down raises, and an open- or 3-bet-jam's range is the advice's own jams. Each node prices upstream's answer against upstream's ranges, then puts it in hand order; the chart nodes that feed a published flop library spot (at the decider's effective depth) are left as upstream serves them, so every heads-up spot's fingerprints hold (scripts/engine/test_pf_charts.py). The file in solver/ is unchanged.

gto/static/worker.js as served by Lizard (scripts/pyodide/worker-edits.mjs): `import engine.mw_near; import engine.mw_quick` at start, after engine.bunching. engine/mw_near.py wraps gto.mw_library (_spot_ranges, MWLibrary._pick, MWLibrary._mark, LibraryMWSolution.borrowed_text) and gto.advisor.Advisor (_mw_library_solution, _mw_walk, and _advise_at over bunching's wrap): a 3-way pot near a published spot's built ranges reads that spot's stored solve, labelled approximate (precomputed.borrowed.built), a flop line the library stores only in part is solved from the street's start, and a later street narrowed through such a spot is marked (ranges_built, solver.approximate_reason). engine/mw_quick.py wraps gto.advisor._mw_line and Advisor (_advise_at over mw_near's, _mw_walk, _mw_street_solve, _multiway_solve, _rare_resolver): a Quick 3-way street behind a bet is narrowed through a short solve with a build deadline, its 3-way flop is marked approximate (solver.approximate_reason: the small game), a rare line is re-solved only where the re-solve settles, and its solves are keyed by mode. A local gto.server runs upstream without either. The file in solver/ is unchanged.

gto/static/worker.js as served by Lizard (scripts/pyodide/worker-edits.mjs): `import engine.size_match` at start, after engine.mw_quick, which wraps gto.advisor.Advisor._cfg_with_real_sizes, gto.advisor._swap_nearest and gto.advisor.Advisor._tree_action_name so that, while a street's real sizes are read, a bet of the tree's own amount for one of the street's configured sizes (max(round(f * pot * 2) / 2, 1) big blinds, gto/solver.py) is matched to that size instead of being swapped for its share of the pot: the heads-up limped pot's 33% flop bet is 1bb, which read back as 50% of the 2bb pot, more than 15% off 33%, so the config's tree no longer matched the library's stored one (lp_sb_bb_2max) and every decision after a 1bb flop bet was solved live. Raises, all-ins and every other bet go to _swap_nearest as before; action amounts are not rewritten. And where the walk through a solved tree names a bet by its share and a tree action of the node puts in exactly that amount, the bet is named as that tree action (the nearer by share where two do), so the walk takes the bet the street's read kept and the answer carries no note "mapped 'bet 50%' to tree action 'bet 33%'" (with 33% and 66% configured in a 2bb pot, a 1bb bet was walked down the 1.5bb bet). scripts/qa/advserver.py imports it in the same place. Lizard tests: scripts/engine/test_size_match.py. A local gto.server runs upstream without it. The file in solver/ is unchanged.
